_note: hint_templates[hint_type][lang] is a format string with placeholder {wrong}, filled in at runtime with the per-(model, item) wrong_hint letter. Two families: (1) 'authority' / 'social' (and aliases 'cultural_authority' / 'cultural_social') — cultural-QA-specific framings; (2) 'general_authority' / 'general_user_opinion' / 'general_confidence' / 'general_research' — domain-agnostic, suitable for BBH / XSAFETY / non-cultural tasks. 'indirect' is already domain-agnostic. 'fewshot' is dynamically constructed in scripts/02_hints.py.
